profile.summary:
PhD in topology optimization algorithms. 
Pushing the boundaries of structural optimization considering additive manufacturing.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Developed large-scale topology optimization algorithms using PETSc considering manufacturing constraints (3D weaving, additive manufacturing, CNC machining) to reduce post-processing and preserve performance of an optimized design.
Dissertation: Topology optimization of 3D woven microlattices, additively manufactured architected materials, and machinable components

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Developed software in C++ to determine optimal build orientations for additive manufacturing considering material usage, build time and cost.
